Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Singh,Prashant Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 15 years was enticed by someone and was missing.
Subsequently, in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C, the victim stated that her cousin sister with whom she had a fight and she left in a fit of anger towards the agricultural fields.
She also stated that her cousin brother had beaten her and when she came home, she was beaten by her parents and thereafter she once again went to he agricultural field.

No allegation was leveled against anyone, however in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C, the victim stated that one boy used to misbehaved with her and 8-9 days ago, he had committed wrong Indrabhan @ Chhotu vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.

The medical on record did not corroborate any allegation of use of force.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

4. Considering the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. wherein the applicant was named for the first time, there being no corroboration to the medical on record, the applicant who is in custody since 22.05.2024 is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Indrabhan @ Chhotu be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 278 of 2024,
under Sections 323, 363, 376(2) N IPC and Section 5(L)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar,
District Gonda, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
